source: Split from the module it belonged to; one lesson per day-module.

lessons.title: Play it, watch it, plan it
lessons.objective: Play the finished game first, watch how the table is built, then plan it and meet the pieces: a scene turned into a game, and a table with a goal.

lessons.title: Build the table in small steps
lessons.objective: Build the table one lab at a time: a bouncy ball, walls and a ground, a tilted bumper, and a goal to hit.
